findings.decision: An omitted style definition defaults to paragraph style 0. Do not remove implicit style 0 or case-sensitive control handling to match Writer.

RTF writers supply style properties with the paragraph or character run. Readers may differ when only a style number is supplied. The previous 32 shorthand samples do not alone establish a product defect.
Paragraph properties can occur inside a paragraph. This does not settle how a named paragraph style without accompanying character formatting affects each run in independently scoped groups.

disposition.prior32: Retained without replacing expected output or claiming resolved. Missing/default style and mid-paragraph differences need an authoritative application fixture with expanded properties before product changes.
disposition.font24: All reader/Cocoa/Writer outputs agree. Eight sources with explicit font expansion recover the intended non-Latin text. Sixteen unexpanded sources are decoded by all three as document-default bytes; original intended text is diagnostic, not substituted as an oracle contract.
disposition.next: Rotate to the three already reproduced CommonMark code/container cases; revisit RTF with exported application fixtures.

generation.recipe: Encode the recorded encodedText using its named legacy encoding, escape every byte as RTF hex, combine font table charset mapping with each stylesheet/body form. Every complete input is retained below with SHA-256.
